rootCause: Live v1.7.7 session: a 33.7-minute EIC turn triggered Greenfield's own stale-ladder F5 (tabs.reload of the same /c/ conversation) at 30 minutes; the new content documentId was treated as a session boundary, so turn 2 went out FULL (DOCUMENT_OR_CONVERSATION_CHANGED).
operatorDecision: Same conversation = COMPACT: a reload of the same ChatGPT conversation (Greenfield stale-ladder F5/Ctrl-F5 or manual F5) is not a prompt-profile boundary.
change: Prompt continuity anchored on lastResponse.observation.conversationKey (conversation of the causally paired response) instead of content documentId; dispatch guard compares conversation only.

boundaries.e2eScope: real background.js send/wait/capture/analyze path in the Node harness; offscreen LanguageModel mocked
